subject: Can I change my account name on shinyapps.io? If not, how do I delete the account and create a new one?

messages.author: ea11a7a12a3e1e0b
messages.subject: Can I change my account name on shinyapps.io? If not, how do I delete the account and create a new one?
parts:
I recently signed up a new account with my work address, but accidentally put in the wrong account name, which I can see is also used as a URL for my apps. I would really like to edit this, but cannot find a way of doing so. If I can't edit it, I would like to delete the account so that I can open a new one with the correct account name - but can't find out how to do that either.

Any help would be much appreciated, thanks!

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Can I change my account name on shinyapps.io? If not, how do I delete the account and create a new one?
parts:
Lara,

You can change your account name by logging into the shinyapps.io dashboard, and going to the "Account / Settings" page. There is a button to "Rename Account".

-Andy
